tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Brand black, never #000000. Primary text, primary button fill, promo banner, nav text; fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page canvas, button text on black, nav bar; fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: grey-50
tokens.usage: Snow. Lightest near-white differentiation.

tokens.name: grey-100
tokens.usage: Light grey. Input and search fill, image placeholder, loading skeleton, icon-button fill.

tokens.name: grey-200
tokens.usage: Hover background, disabled button fill, the 1px inset divider.

tokens.name: grey-300
tokens.usage: Subtle and input borders, outlined-button border; also hover fill of a white button on dark. Decorative contrast only (1.6:1 on white).

tokens.name: grey-400
tokens.usage: Disabled text on light grounds (2.7:1, exempt as disabled); secondary text on dark grounds (6.2:1 on grey-900).

tokens.name: grey-500
tokens.usage: Secondary text, placeholder, primary border, button hover fill. 4.9:1 on white, 4.5:1 on grey-100.

tokens.name: grey-600
tokens.usage: Disabled text on dark grounds.

tokens.name: grey-700
tokens.usage: Hover state on dark backgrounds.

tokens.name: grey-800
tokens.usage: Primary background of dark, inverted sections.

tokens.name: grey-900
tokens.usage: Deep charcoal. Inverse primary background, darkest non-black surface.

tokens.name: red-600
tokens.usage: Critical: errors, sale badges, urgent notices. 5.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: red-500
tokens.usage: Brighter red for emphasis. On grey-900 only 3.6:1: use at 24px+ or as a border.

tokens.name: orange-badge
tokens.usage: Badge text and promotional callouts on white (4.8:1).

tokens.name: orange-400
tokens.usage: Expressive orange for campaigns; never UI chrome.

tokens.name: green-600
tokens.usage: Success, availability, positive states on white (5.2:1).

tokens.name: green-500
tokens.usage: Success on dark grounds (5.4:1 on grey-900).

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: Text links and informational highlights on white (5.8:1).

tokens.name: blue-400
tokens.usage: Links and focus on dark grounds (5.1:1 on grey-900).

tokens.name: yellow-200
tokens.usage: Warning backgrounds and attention banners; black text on it holds 14:1.

tokens.name: focus-blue
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on light grounds (6.1:1 on white). On grey-900 it drops to 2.7:1, so the Dark theme's focus uses blue-400.

tokens.name: ramp-red-50
tokens.usage: Red ramp, lightest. Campaign and product contexts only.

tokens.name: ramp-red-900

tokens.usage: Orange ramp, lightest.

tokens.name: ramp-orange-900

tokens.usage: Yellow ramp, lightest.

tokens.usage: Green ramp, lightest.

tokens.usage: Teal ramp, lightest.

tokens.name: ramp-teal-base
tokens.usage: Teal ramp, core.

tokens.name: ramp-teal-900
tokens.usage: Teal ramp, deepest.

tokens.name: ramp-blue-50
tokens.usage: Blue ramp, lightest.

tokens.name: ramp-blue-900
tokens.usage: Blue ramp, deepest.

tokens.usage: Purple ramp, lightest.

tokens.name: ramp-purple-base
tokens.usage: Purple ramp, core.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Dark: the inverse primary background.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Secondary ground, input and search fill, image placeholder.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover background of quiet controls.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, body, nav links on surface and surface-alt (14:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Descriptions, metadata, prices labels, placeholders on surface and surface-alt (4.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Inactive elements and unavailable options (disabled text is exempt from contrast minimums).

tokens.name: border-primary
tokens.usage: Standard border and hovered outline; meets 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: border-secondary
tokens.usage: Subtle borders, input borders and dividers. Below 3:1 (source value kept): never the only cue that a control exists.

tokens.name: border-active
tokens.usage: Active or focused input border.

tokens.name: button-fill
tokens.usage: Primary pill fill; on dark sections the white 'primary on dark'.

tokens.name: button-text
tokens.usage: Label on button-fill.

tokens.name: button-hover
tokens.usage: Primary pill fill on hover. White label on grey-500 holds 4.9:1.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Errors and sale. Dark theme value is 3.6:1 on surface: 24px+ text, borders and badges only.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmation and availability; always paired with a word.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring on every interactive element.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning banner fill; text on it is black.

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: Promotional badge text such as 'Just In' or 'Bestseller'.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dark scrim under text on photography. Alpha is an assumption; the source gives no value.

families.display: "Nike Futura ND", Oswald, "Helvetica Now Text Medium", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.heading: "Helvetica Now Display Medium", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.text: "Helvetica Now Text", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Condensed, uppercase, 0.90 leading. Never below 24px. Oswald stands in where the custom face is unavailable.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headlines only, always uppercase. Steps down to 64px then 48px on smaller screens.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Weight 500 for anything interactive; 400 only for plain copy and legal.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight icon gaps; product-grid gap at its tightest.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Base unit; button icon gaps; promo banner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card internal padding; gap between product image and its text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard padding, nav spacing, mobile page padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Product card gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section internal padding, grid gaps, tablet page padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section breaks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Major section padding; desktop page padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero section padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large section spacing.

radius.note: Imagery is sharp; only UI gets rounded corners.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Product images and hero photography.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Form inputs other than search.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small interactive elements.

tokens.name: radius-container
tokens.usage: Containers and cards holding UI content.

tokens.name: radius-search
tokens.usage: Search inputs and medium pills.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags and filters.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Circular icon buttons and avatar placeholders.

shadow.note: Radically flat: no card shadows, no hover lifts. Only the inset divider and the focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-divider
tokens.usage: The single divider between sections.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on light grounds.

breakpoint.note: Minimum widths of each layout tier.

tokens.name: bp-small-tablet
tokens.usage: Two-column product grid begins; nav still collapsed.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Two-column grids, 24px page padding.

tokens.name: bp-small-desktop
tokens.usage: Full horizontal nav, three-column product grid.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Full layout, 48px page padding.

tokens.name: bp-large
tokens.usage: Centered max-width container.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max container width.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Standard content width.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Desktop nav bar height.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target.

tokens.name: touch-nav
tokens.usage: Mobile nav icon touch area.

tokens.name: pill-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum filter pill height.
